title: System Checkup
empty-state.log-initial: Click refresh to check recent log activity.

journal-size.title: System logs are using {size}
journal-size.ok-detail: This is normal — no action needed.
journal-size.action-detail: Your logs are taking up a fair amount of space. Cleaning up older entries is safe.
journal-size.unavailable-detail: Couldn't read log disk usage right now.

pacnew.warn-detail: An update changed a config file's defaults but didn't touch your customized copy. Review each file listed below (run 'sudo pacdiff' in a terminal, or diff them by hand) — this won't happen automatically, since merging config files by mistake can break things.

cache-size.title: Package cache is using {size}
cache-size.ok-detail: This is normal — no action needed.
cache-size.action-detail: Old downloaded package files are piling up. Cleaning up keeps the most recent versions and removes the rest.
cache-size.no-tool-detail: Old downloaded package files are piling up. Install 'pacman-contrib' to enable one-click cleanup.
cache-size.unavailable-detail: Couldn't read the package cache size right now.

arch-news.warn-detail: Arch sometimes needs a manual step before a big update. Read the news before your next update to be safe.
arch-news.unavailable-detail: Install 'informant' to get warned before an update needs a manual step.
arch-news.failed-detail: The news feed check failed (often just a temporary network hiccup) — it'll try again on the next check.

vulnerable-packages.ok-detail: None of your installed packages have known security issues.
vulnerable-packages.warn-detail: Updating these packages would fix known security issues in them.
vulnerable-packages.unavailable-detail: Install 'arch-audit' to check installed packages against known CVEs.
vulnerable-packages.failed-detail: The vulnerability check failed — it'll try again on the next check.

firewall.ok-detail: nftables is configured to block unsolicited incoming connections.
firewall.configured-detail: A firewall config exists but doesn't look like a default-deny setup — worth a look if you're not sure what it allows.
firewall.none-detail: Nothing is blocking unsolicited incoming connections. Consider setting one up if this machine is ever on an untrusted network.
firewall.other-tool-detail: A firewall tool is installed, but this plugin only reads nftables config directly right now.

listening-ports.none-title: Nothing listening beyond your own machine
listening-ports.none-detail: No apps are accepting connections from outside.
listening-ports.some-title: {count} port(s) open to more than just your own machine
listening-ports.some-detail: Usually normal app behavior (media/game discovery, remote-play, etc.) — see Details for what's listening. Worth a second look only if something surprises you.

ssh-exposure.warn-detail: Remote login is enabled on this machine — worth confirming that's intended and that you're using a strong key or password.

failed-logins.ok-detail: Nothing suspicious in the last 7 days.
failed-logins.warn-title: {count} failed sudo attempt(s) in the last 7 days
failed-logins.warn-detail: Usually just a mistyped password. Worth a second look if you don't recognize the activity.

poll-interval-minutes.label: Check interval (minutes)
poll-interval-minutes.description: How often to re-run the maintenance checklist in the background.

enable-security-glance.label: Enable Security Glance
enable-security-glance.description: Adds a section checking for known package vulnerabilities (needs 'arch-audit'), firewall status, open ports, SSH exposure, and failed sudo attempts. Off by default; all checks are read-only.
